endpoint: William S. Payne Memorial Park Susquehanna launch, Bainbridge

sources.publisher: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation
sources.supports: Lists Bainbridge William Payne Park downstream of the Route 206 bridge as a Susquehanna River hard-surface ramp with parking.
Confirms William Payne Park has boat access to the Susquehanna.
Confirms boat launch ramps for the Susquehanna at Payne and Clinton parks.

sourceAssessment: NYSDEC is the controlling launch inventory; municipal pages corroborate that Payne Park is a public Susquehanna access site. The sources support a launch-area anchor, not an exact wet-toe coordinate.
